title: Add Built-in Request Body Validation Middleware
description: Provides a declarative way to validate JSON request bodies against a schema, preventing malformed data from reaching route handlers. This reduces boiler‑plate validation code, improves security, and catches client errors early.
testCases: Valid payload passes and next() is called
Invalid payload returns 400 with detailed error message
Schema with nested objects validates correctly
Custom error formatter can be injected
acceptance: When a route registers the validation middleware with a JSON schema, any incoming request whose body does not conform returns a 400 response containing a clear error description; compliant requests proceed to the next handler without alteration. All new tests pass and existing test suite remains green.
reason: Ensures data integrity at the framework level, eliminating repetitive validation code in applications and reducing runtime errors, which directly improves developer productivity and application reliability.
